title: Letter Re Communist Organization

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
I. B. D. 7029
21 10 35

October 19, 35.

E. Howard, Esq.,
Editor,
North China Daily News.

Dear Howard,

Many thanks for sending round the enclosed article
on communist organisation. I have asked our Special
Branch what they think of it and have received a note in
reply stating that in their opinion the article is of no
value from the point of view of the Police and that from
the point of view of general interest the information is
not very up-to-date.

If your correspondent has any secret confidential
documents of recent date this would, of course, be of
great interest to the Police but in that case, would
probably be quite unsuitable for publication.

It appears then, from our point of view, the articles
are not particularly recommended.

Yours sincerely,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne
Acting Commissioner of Police.

（批：Sent.
In. 21/10）

（印：JAG
21 OCT. 1935）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别科登记处
I. B. D. 7029
35年10月21日

1935年10月19日。

E. Howard 先生，
编辑，
《字林西报》。

亲爱的 Howard：

非常感谢您转来所附关于共产党组织的文章。我已征询我处特别科对此文的看法，并收到回函称，他们认为从警方角度来看，该文章毫无价值；且从公众兴趣的角度来看，其所载信息也非最新。

若您的通讯员持有近期的秘密机密文件，这当然会引起警方的极大兴趣，但在这种情况下，这些文件可能完全不适合公开发表。

因此，从我们的观点来看，并不特别推荐刊登此类文章。

此致

敬礼

（签名）K. M. Bourne
代理警务处处长。

（批注：已发出。
收件日期 21/10）

（印章：JAG
1935年10月21日）

Shanghai Municipal Police
Headquarters.

Date October 18, 1935.

Acting Commissioner,

Sir,

With reference to attached, I do not consider
the article of any value from the point of view of the
Police. The information seems stale and is not likely to
be of any interest to the general public.

J. McEwen
D. C. (Sp.Br.)
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
总部。

日期：1935年10月18日。

代理警务处处长，

阁下：

关于附件，我认为从警方角度来看，该文章没有任何价值。所载信息似乎已过时，不太可能引起公众的任何兴趣。

J. McEwen
副督察长（特别科）

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS
THE NORTH-CHINA HERALD (WEEKLY)
ESTABLISHED 1850
POSTAL ADDRESS: P.O. BOX 707, SHANGHAI
TELEGRAMS: HERALD SHANGHAI
EDITOR'S OFFICE

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. D. REGISTRY
SHANGHAI, CHINA B.D. 7029
21 / 10 35
17th Oct., 1935

Major K. M. Bourne, M.C.,
Office of Commissioner of Police,
Administration Building

My dear Bourne,

I have received information from a correspondent
that he had some interesting communist material and he
tentatively asked me whether he should submit articles
on the subject. I enclose a specimen of the first
article. Do you think it is of any value from the point
of view of published information? Sorry to bother you.

Yours sincerely,
E. Hayward
Editor

D C (Sp Br)
For comment & action
please.

（印：OFFICE OF COMMISSIONER OF POLICE 18 OCT.）

《字林西报》
《字林周报》
创刊于1850年
邮政地址：上海信箱707号
电报挂号：HERALD SHANGHAI
编辑部

上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. D. 登记处
中国上海 B.D. 7029
35年10月21日
1935年10月17日

K. M. Bourne 少校，军功十字勋章获得者，
警务处处长办公室，
行政大厦

亲爱的 Bourne：

我收到一位通讯员的消息，称他掌握一些有趣的共产党材料，并试探性地询问我是否应提交有关此主题的文章。现附上第一篇文章的样本。您认为从已发表信息的角度来看，它有任何价值吗？抱歉打扰您。

此致

敬礼
E. Hayward
编辑

副督察长（特别科）
请阅示并采取行动。

（印章：警务处处长办公室 10月18日）
